entries.name: Adyen
entries.rationale: Payments provider with several credential types (API keys, client keys, webhook HMAC keys) that need telling apart.

entries.name: Airtable
entries.rationale: Widely used personal access tokens, with older API keys still around; both appear in scripts and automation configs.

entries.name: Algolia
entries.rationale: Search keys range from public search-only to secret admin keys: a ready-made public-versus-secret pair to document.

entries.name: Auth0
entries.rationale: Identity provider with client secrets and management API tokens, next to public client identifiers.

entries.name: Bitbucket
entries.rationale: Source host with several credential types (repository, workspace, app passwords) that the vendor documents.

entries.name: Brevo
entries.rationale: Email and marketing API keys, comparable to the mail providers already recorded.

entries.name: CircleCI
entries.rationale: CI service whose personal and project tokens are routinely pasted into pipeline configs.

entries.name: Cloudinary
entries.rationale: Media credentials are often written as a URL with an embedded secret, a shape the recorded families barely cover.

entries.name: DeepSeek
entries.rationale: Model API keys, in the same demand class as the other model providers already recorded.

entries.name: Dropbox
entries.rationale: Access tokens of different lifetimes, with documented differences between them to check.

entries.name: LaunchDarkly
entries.rationale: Feature-flag service with server-side SDK keys, client-side IDs and mobile keys: a public-versus-secret split inside one provider.

entries.name: PagerDuty
entries.rationale: Incident-response API keys and integration keys, which differ in sensitivity.

entries.name: PlanetScale
entries.rationale: Database service with service tokens and connection passwords whose documented prefix scheme is worth verifying.

entries.name: Postmark
entries.rationale: Transactional email with separate server and account tokens; check whether their shape collides with ordinary identifiers.

entries.name: Render
entries.rationale: Hosting platform whose API keys appear in deploy scripts.

entries.name: Segment
entries.rationale: Analytics service with write keys that ship in client code and secret access tokens that must not: another public-versus-secret pair.

entries.name: Snowflake
entries.rationale: Data platform with programmatic access tokens and key-pair authentication material.

entries.name: Snyk
entries.rationale: Security tooling whose API tokens sit in CI configuration; check whether the shape collides with plain identifiers.

entries.name: Square
entries.rationale: Payments provider with access tokens and application secrets, plus documented sandbox values.

entries.name: Upstash
entries.rationale: Serverless Redis and Kafka with REST tokens used in client code.

entries.name: Zendesk
entries.rationale: Support platform with API tokens and OAuth client secrets embedded in integrations.
